## PR #8663 received and verified. ⭐ This card's own census was FALSE, in a way that would have shipped a silent break — and the dev found it before writing the change

`domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`, reading taken **2026-09-08T20:50Z** (clock re-read immediately before writing this stamp).

**Verified by this seat, ⛔ not taken from the report:** PR #8663, head `9038177`, **draft**, 22 changed files, +360/−69, 1 commit, body opens `Fixes #7357`. Labels include **`needs:contract-review`** ⇒ **双载体 satisfied** — carrier on the PR and on this card.

## ⭐⭐ The falsification that matters

This card states, from `origin/main` `ec0a7b84`:

> The snake spelling has **no framework-level producer**: no bridge, no spec, no generated metadata writes it.

**That is false, and the exception is load-bearing.** `packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts:185` emitted `depends_on: param.dependsOn` onto the `Record` bag that `ActionParamDialog` hands straight to the field widgets — **which is exactly where `LookupField` read it.** The whole chain is in-repo:

```
resolveActionParams()  → emits ActionParamDef.dependsOn   (camel)
paramToField()         → re-spelled it to depends_on      ← the producer the census missed
ActionParamDialog      → passes the bag as the widget `field` prop
LookupField            → read fieldMeta.depends_on
```

⇒ **Executing this card literally — "remove the `depends_on` read arm in `LookupField`" — would have silently killed dependent lookups in every action-param dialog.** ⛔ With **no type error anywhere**, because that bag is an untyped record of string keys to `any`, so neither the member deletion nor the arm deletion can reach it. The failure would have surfaced as "the cascade just stopped working", in a dialog, for a user.

The dev converted the emit **at the producer** rather than keeping a renderer-side dialect alive — which is what AGENTS.md **#0.1** requires, and the right half of the seam to fix.

⭐ **This is the third consecutive card in this lane where the implementer refused or corrected its brief and was right**, and the pattern is now worth stating: #8583 (the ruling's `:100` docblock did not exist, and its "zero `collapsed:` in any test" was false on its own census SHA); #8345 (the parity census collision, measured by ablation instead of guessed); and now this one, against a **maintainer-ruled** card. ⇒ **A ruling's stated measurement is still a measurement, and can be false** — and the cheapest place to catch it is the implementer who has to build on it.

## The other two corrections, both recorded rather than smoothed

- ⛔ **This card's third pin is UNMEASURABLE from this repository.** It names `examples/app-showcase` cascading-select and invoice-to-contact. **That directory does not exist in objectui** — control: `examples/` holds `byo-backend-console`, `console-starter`, `hello-world`, `schema-catalog`. It lives in the sibling `objectstack` repo (`AGENTS.md:529`), and its objectui-side driver `e2e/live/cascading-options.spec.ts` needs a real backend and is excluded from the default run. ⇒ Recorded **NOT MEASURED**, ⛔ not quietly dropped. What is measurable and was measured: the showcase cascade is authored with `dependsOn`, and no in-repo e2e authors the retired spelling.
- **The pin "a metadata object carrying only `depends_on` no longer gates the select" was ALREADY true before this card** — `SelectField` has only ever read `field?.dependsOn`. A pin that passes identically before and after proves nothing about the change, and the dev states it as such instead of presenting it as evidence.

## The inverted text-scan pin — the direction is right this time

`plugin-grid`'s `relationalMetaCopySet.derivation.test.ts` reads `LookupField.tsx` **by identifier text**. On PR #8609 it went red for this reason and the fix was to **widen the scanner**, because the reads were still live and deleting the reader entry would have asserted a falsehood. ⭐ **Here the read really goes away**, so the entry is retired and the scanner is ⛔ not widened — and the dev kept the control's *shape* requirement alive on the untouched `lookup_columns` / `lookupColumns` pair, so the block still tests what it was built to test.

## The fence held, and it was measured rather than assumed

The card told the dev to check `packages/types/src/zod/` for a mirror — a directory this round's fence puts off-limits. The dev measured it **absent** before touching anything: `depends_on` there = **0** (exit 1) against a **live control** of `dependsOn` = 2 in the same directory, and `BaseFieldMetadata` appears 0 times in the whole directory. ⇒ There is no mirror, nothing to edit, and **no fenced file was opened.** Every other fenced path was greped to 0 with its own live control, and two of them (`strict-authoring-face.ts`, `vite.config.ts`) do not exist on this base at all — they are files the held PRs add.

## Carrier and state

⛔ `needs:contract-review` stays on **both**. A **ceiling-tier review is running**, with the producer falsification as its named centre — a near-miss on a ruled card earns more review budget than anything else on this PR. ⛔ PR #8663 is not ready, not enqueued, no auto-merge.

⚠️ One reading to carry: `check:node-esm-load` is red under plain invocation here (the shared `.turbo/cache` provenance mechanism, foreign entries from sibling worktrees, neither package in this diff) and green under its own `--force-build` remedy. ⛔ That gate is **not** a per-PR CI check, so it is measured here or nowhere — both runs are in the PR body, which is the right way to report it.
